```{=html}
<section class="collaborate-section">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="collaborate-content">
      <h1>Collaborate with AffineDrift</h1>
      
      <div class="collaborate-intro">
        <p>
          AffineDrift is an open research project focused on understanding the biomechanics of the golf swing 
          through the lens of control-affine systems and multibody dynamics. We welcome collaboration, 
          contributions, and suggestions from researchers, engineers, and golf enthusiasts.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="collaborate-options">
        <div class="collaborate-card">
          <h2>Suggest a Resource</h2>
          <p>
            Have you found a paper, book, video, or tool that would be valuable to the AffineDrift community? 
            We're always looking to expand our resources section with high-quality materials related to:
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li>Control theory and robotics</li>
            <li>Biomechanics and sports science</li>
            <li>Mathematical modeling and simulation</li>
            <li>Golf instruction and swing analysis</li>
          </ul>
          <p>
            Please reach out via the <a href="contact.html">contact form</a> with your suggestions, 
            including a brief description of why the resource would be valuable.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="collaborate-card">
          <h2>Collaborate on the Repository</h2>
          <p>
            Interested in contributing code, models, or documentation to the AffineDrift project? 
            We welcome contributions in several areas:
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li>Mathematical models and simulations (Matlab Simulink, MuJoCo, Drake, Pinnochio)</li>
            <li>Interactive visualizations and tools</li>
            <li>Documentation and tutorials</li>
            <li>Code improvements and bug fixes</li>
          </ul>
          <p>
            Get in touch to discuss collaboration opportunities, review our development guidelines, 
            or propose new features. We're particularly interested in expanding our collection of 
            pendulum models and biomechanical simulations.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="collaborate-card">
          <h2>Make Suggestions</h2>
          <p>
            Have ideas for improving the website, research directions, or new topics to explore? 
            We value feedback and suggestions from the community. Whether it's:
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li>Website improvements and user experience</li>
            <li>Research questions or experimental ideas</li>
            <li>New article topics or analysis approaches</li>
            <li>Model improvements or extensions</li>
          </ul>
          <p>
            Your input helps shape the direction of AffineDrift. Please use the 
            <a href="contact.html">contact form</a> to share your thoughts and suggestions.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="collaborate-contact">
        <p>
          <strong>Ready to collaborate?</strong> The best way to get started is to reach out via the 
          <a href="contact.html">contact form</a> or email us directly at 
          <a href="mailto:dieterolson@AffineDrift.com">dieterolson@AffineDrift.com</a>. 
          We'll respond as soon as possible to discuss how we can work together.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
